title: Seeing a UFO while remote viewing Mount Zeal

tellings.quote: Not in a hangar. will uh in the viewing of uh Mount Hayes uh Mount um Mount Zeal.

plain: A former US Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan says he once trained in remote viewing, the practice of trying to describe a distant place using only the mind. He says that during one session, while viewing a mountain in Australia he calls Mount Zeal, he saw a UFO, and that it was not sitting in a hangar. If true, it would suggest the mind can pick up unknown craft at places it cannot see.
